items.title: Actual Gaussian norm and bias signal strength

items.statement: In the original uniform query regime, the actual target Gaussian has a norm mean and normalized-bias signal bounded below at the displayed rates. M\ge\frac{d}{2\sqrt\kappa}\ge\frac12d^{(1+\delta)/2},\qquad M\beta^2\ge\frac{B^2}{2}\sqrt d,\qquad B=(1-e^{-4})e^{-3}. Fix a real \(\delta\) with \(0<\delta<1\). There exists one natural \(d_0(\delta)\), chosen before every varying dimension, condition parameter and query cap. For every natural \(d\ge d_0(\delta)\), real \(2\le\kappa\le d^{1-\delta}\), and natural \(q\ge0\) with \(q\le(\delta/256)\sqrt\kappa\log d\), set \(n=2q+1\). The cap includes \(q=0\) and has the source integer-cap meaning; no expected-cost adapter is asserted. Use the literal midpoint precision spectrum \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean reindexes the same grid by zero-based \(\mathrm{Fin}\,d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\), \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\), \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\), and \(\beta=|\mathbb E Q(U)|/M\). These are actual integrals under the same Gaussian; the covariance is inverse precision. Lean \(b\) denotes the source \(\mu_n\), while Lean \(B\) denotes the source positive constant \(b\). \(M>0\), \(\beta>0\), dimension/mode/gap validity, finite moments and all power/log/square-root domains are conclusions or internally supplied canonical facts. No moment, law, growth, gap, signal or probability certificate is an extra input.
